svg.title: A regular pentagon lying in a plane, shown twice: once with a rotation axis perpendicular to the plane through its center (n rotations by 2 pi k over n), once with an axis lying in the plane through a vertex and the center (n flips by pi); to the right, the degenerate polygons for n = 1 (a loop with one marked vertex) and n = 2 (a lens with two marked vertices).
